title: centaurea balsamita subsp. kermanensis
intro: Centaurea balsamita subsp. kermanensis, commonly known as Kerman giant knapweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Centaurea balsamita subsp. kermanensis include its potential to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
